manual_review.preflight: Official main 0x4023c0ac calls the outer-header-only probe at 0x7bd4fad3, then checks version/build fields. The probe calls 0x7bd4ed0a, which reads and checks the 512-byte UPD header; it does not call the full decoder or ECDSA verifier.
manual_review.separate_installation: Main installation handler 0x4023bb23 calls bridge 0x4023c141, which calls the full update job 0x7bd4fb8f. That job sets the key/profile/unsigned allowance and invokes full decoding via 0x7bd4ee4a before later programming operations.
manual_review.unsigned: The installed job at 0x7bd4fb93 loads RAM 0x70a68490 at 0x7bd4fb97; zero enables context+112. Installed inner-marker branch 0x7bd4f14b admits marker byte zero only with that allowance, bypassing ECDSA on that branch.
manual_review.prompt_interpretation: Reaching a confirmation prompt alone does not demonstrate ECDSA bypass or successful full payload validation. The preflight and installation request handlers are separate; complete UI-state ordering is not yet traced.
